exposure: Small for Gestational Age (SGA) at birth
Large for Gestational Age (LGA) at birth
cohort: Healthy singleton term infants born in the French South region between January 2017 and November 2018.
finding: LGA infants had a 20% higher odds of being hospitalized than those born AGA, with infectious diseases being a main cause, while SGA was not significantly associated with hospital readmission.
birth_weight: SGA defined as <10th percentile and LGA as >90th percentile, according to sex and gestational age, with AGA as the reference.
gest_age: Term infants were included, and gestational age was used to define SGA and LGA percentiles.
